> Protocol audit: this is a 128-frame local matched lazy first-correspondence Top-4 experiment. It does not reproduce SAF3R paper Table 4 (DINO feature Top-K; 300/500/700 frames; FastVGGT protocol). See docs/experiments/scannet50_paper_protocol_audit.md.

Local measurements, 128 uniform valid frames; AUC/F1 percentages, distances metres. F1=0.05 m, voxel=0.05 m, confidence>=1.0. Reconstruction: predicted depth and poses, camera-centre Sim(3), incremental voxel fusion, mesh vertices as GT, no ICP or distance clipping. Speedup=Dense warmed median / method warmed median on same physical GPU; 1 warmup + 3 measurements. Macro requires all 50 scenes. SAF3R lazy first-correspondence Top-4, eth3d-train-fltr-calib_cmpmse profile.
